overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 1-2 Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a rejuvenating wellness experience right at home. Designed for compact spaces, this sauna combines the natural beauty of Canadian Hemlock wood with advanced infrared technology, featuring 5 heaters including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR carbon panels for safe, effective heat. Enjoy the benefits of muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation, enhanced by the soothing glow of Himalayan salt bars and chromotherapy lighting. Ideal for indoor settings like basements or master baths, it also boasts a touch screen control panel with Bluetooth connectivity for a truly personalized retreat.
